name: Palo Brunch Signature Parmesan-Crusted Chicken Breast over Arborio Risotto
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Arguably the single most famous dish on Disney Cruise Line: tender pounded chicken breast in a light 24-month Parmigiano-Reggiano crust over creamy white Arborio rice risotto.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order as your centerpiece Palo Brunch entrée; aged Parmigiano-Reggiano is naturally lactose-free, though take a Lactaid for the butter/cream in the risotto.
